arguments.promptText: Photoreal garden maintenance film in soft warm afternoon light: deep moss-green lawn, pale limestone border, clipped hedges, olive tree in background. One continuous fixed elevated rear three-quarter shot. The lawn's long straight axis runs bottom-to-top. A groundskeeper pushes an unbranded walk-behind mower with a rear striping roller slowly AWAY from camera, bottom toward top, in one straight lane. At the start the entire center lane AHEAD of the mower is uniform, unstriped green grass. Only two previously cut straight parallel bands sit to its LEFT, aligned with its direction of travel. The center lane has no pre-existing stripe or track. As the mower advances, its wheels visibly roll and the rear roller contacts the grass. A single fresh darker, mower-width band progressively appears ONLY directly BEHIND the roller, growing from the mower's starting position along the exact path it has traveled. Grass ahead stays uniform until the mower actually reaches it. The newly made stripe is parallel to the two neighboring stripes, never crossing them. Show the physical cause and effect clearly in real time. Realistic mower geometry, natural walking, steady speed, no sideways motion or turns. Keep mower, roller and forming stripe in the middle of the image for a narrow website crop. Calm editorial realism, no scene cuts, captions, logos or graphic overlays.

arguments.promptText: Photoreal horizontal 16:9 garden maintenance film, warm soft afternoon light, deep green grass beside pale limestone paving and clipped hedges. A continuous locked-off LOW CLOSE-UP of a real powered wheeled lawn EDGER working exactly along the grass/paving boundary. The center of the frame shows the edger's vertical metal cutting disc under its semicircular safety guard, its lower arc visibly buried in the narrow soil seam. The steel disc spins rapidly with natural radial motion blur; small loose grass clippings and tiny soil grains visibly flick backward ONLY from its contact with the grass. The guide wheel rolls on the paving while the operator's boots step slowly behind and the machine advances along the boundary. Ahead of the blade, a small irregular fringe of grass overhangs the stone. Behind the moving blade, that fringe has actually been cut away, leaving a crisp straight grass edge and clean narrow soil groove. Show real cause and effect: continuous powered rotation, contact, cutting and displaced clippings. Tool stays grounded and never hovers. Keep the cutter, contact point and edge centered for a narrow website crop. Authentic restrained gardening, steady camera, realistic machinery, no logos, text, cuts or decorative particle effects.

arguments.promptText: Photoreal horizontal 16:9 garden maintenance film in soft warm afternoon light, pale limestone path beside deep moss-green grass and clipped hedges. One continuous locked-off LOW close shot of a groundskeeper gently clearing a small sparse patch of dry leaves with a leaf blower. The short blower nozzle enters from the upper right, angled downward toward twelve to eighteen tan and brown leaves. Leaves are varied in size, shape and starting angle, initially scattered unevenly with gaps, never a neat row. A brief gentle sweep of the nozzle sends the leaves mostly forward along the path but with a SMALL IRREGULAR SIDEWAYS SCATTER. Each leaf moves independently: some slide, some rotate and roll onto their side, two lighter leaves flutter just a few inches up then settle, one heavier leaf lags and two leaves remain briefly still. Natural unequal speeds, staggered starts, slight random tumbling and small changes of direction, with contact and friction on the stone. Most travel only a short distance, then settle in a loose untidy cluster. No synchronized moving wall, perfect straight line, spiral, huge gust, storm or overly tidy arrangement. Keep the nozzle and leaf action in the center of the picture for a narrow website crop. Calm controlled landscaping work, steady camera, authentic leaf physics, no captions, logos or cuts.
arguments.rationale: Repair overly perfect leaf motion: the user wants a restrained irregular scatter with individual rolling and tumbling, not a uniform tidy line.

tests.review: Leaves begin at irregular angles; independently lift, roll and slide by differing amounts, then settle in a loose cluster. Modest localized scatter, no uniform sweeping wall.
